book.name: Talfut Kese
book.title: Sunbin-Got em Abiil so Kawin so Talfut Kelewse Sang te.

content: Yelew im Ibolow Menew Kesiliw em Sang te.

Beli, beem ding kabalak e, Sekow e atemete: Em fik Iso so, em 400 kel wonuk so kunum iso, alik alik i ba talbiliwi, yetemse kale. Yetemsomi, akalem muluwel bi akalem ketket teben kel waneng im teing dim elo amen amen keyemse kale. Emisik e, e akalem fefe kuluse weng afak waneng alew so, uso ikalem muluwel iso imisik keyemse kale. Keyemse kate, akalem sun waneng Elea so ukalem muluwel iso, ilo umteben keyemsomi, Elesel so um min Yosew so yat biilo fe dim mineng ka koyemse kale.
Koyemsomelei, Sekow akalem e emisik foleko, ben kel ding gatak wakas kawin dim dak kiinguen dukuko, akalem fik em mit mewso tele tele kese kale.
Kelei, fik Iso yako teleko, ning beelo falal kelewsomi, kakatdew kakatdew kelewsomelei, aso i kalfongso amesiliw kale.

Amesomeliwi, Iso e waneng aul alik alik bikati yetemeko, Sekow elo dakalalomele: “Waneng aul min bi kante a?”, dangei, Sekow e yan weng bokolewomele: “Ne kom sak weng afak kunum kebi kate, Sunbin-Got e nelo bamki so kenemsomi, muluwel banso bi dunemse te.”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Sekow em afam weng afak waneng alew biso, ikalem muluwel iso makuw teleko, ikati gatak wakas, katin bukbuk, kawin dak teinsomi, mewso kesiliw kale.

Kesomeliwi, sun waneng Elea so, ukalem muluwel iso teleko, ikati gatak wakas, katin bukbuk, kawin dak teinsomi, mewso kesiliw kale. Anfel e, Elesel so Yosew so yat ikati teleko, gatak wakas, katin bukbuk, kawin dak teinsomi, mewso kesiliw kale.

Keko beli, Iso e ning Sekow elo bokolewomele: “Nem tele tele keli ding dim bakate, ne samal banban nem talbi dulum elo teliwi, yetemsi te. Ku nimtew ibolow mak fukuneko, nem dulum elo yemdaselew a?”, dangse kale. Dangei, Sekow e yan weng bokolewomele: “Kulo ibolow folok so menew so kekemomin beem mongom ete ilo kom teing dim elo yemdasi te!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Iso e ning elo yan weng bokolewomele: “Nawkunum kutaka! Ne on kisol fian so, wiin so kunum kebi kasike, ku kukalem mesesem on kisol be iti aulolewka!”, dangse kate,

Sekow e bokolewomele: “Babo! Ku nelo fein ibolow menew so kenemew tewe, ku on kisol be alik alik fein kulolewka! Feinka! Ne kom kiinguen so, kom ibolow menew beso atemeko, fukunomeli: ‘Ai! Sunbin-Got em kiinguen atemsi emdiw kai!’, angi te.

Kasike kame, ku on kisol so, bamki so eisneng be sak kuw kulolewka! Feinka! Sunbin-Got e nelo bamki banban so kenemse kasike, ne atin kuw ki kebi te.”, dangse kale. Dangeko, Sekow e fik Iso elo kak kelewei, fe e, Iso e on kisol be fein kuluse kale.
Kulusomelei, Iso e ning elo bokolewomele: “Kame nu alik alik makuw unuma o! Ne yuso makuw unoki te!”, dangse kale.

Dangse kate, Sekow e yan weng bokolewomele: “Kamok kutaka! Kukal atebelew: Nem aul beliw i kitil kun so kelinba biliwi, samal ikal men kesomeliwi, mali i auk um non wanbiliw kasike, nu makmak ding kuw kitil kuw kesomi, singam unemuw tewe, mali samal bi fein kuanokoliw te.

Kasike, komisik unolewka! Unbelew kano, kom weng afak kunum nete awkol finengda gili gili ibik ete toloki te. Sowete, ne so, nakalem samal biso, nakalem waneng aul biso, alik alik nu kukalem abiw fian em wiin Seil kalo tolokoluw te.”, dangse kale.

Dangei, fik Iso e bokolewomele: “Kenka. Kate, nakalem weng afak kunum mali mak kuso kamde telina!”, dangse kate, Sekow e iti yan weng mak bokolewomele: “Babo! Kamok a! Ku kanelom beemdiw kanelokolew te! Ken kukuw kuw kanenemselew kasike!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, fein e, Iso e ilo koyemeko, akalem Idom aneng em abiw fian sel Seil kalo unse kale.
Unei, Sekow akati uneko, abiw mak teleko, am geko, akalem samal im belbil tem am akati gese kale. Gesomelei, i abiw ka em wiin e “Sukot”
, dangsiliw kale.
Sekow em Sekem Abiw Mutuk Fian elo Unse em Sang te.

Beli, Sekow e fein Mesofotemia aneng fian elo koleweko, iti Kenan aneng fian kalo uneko, fe e, iti Sekem abiw mutuk fian elo talse kale. Telesomelei, abiw mutuk fian beem ataan talakabe dim beem dim dulum kel akalem samal kal benemin am be kanis daung kanel daung mose kale.
Akalem am geko, mose kawin beem kayak e kunum mak em wiin “Kamol” kese kale. Kese kasike, Sekow e tum win on kisol 100 kuluko, kawin beem yan wese kale. Kamol e Sekem em alew kese kale.
Keko beli, Sekow e aik ayem mak fakalako, beem wiin e “El Eloke Isalael”
, angse kale.

footnotes.text: 33:17 Suda im weng sin e “Sukot” e wiin mongom so. Em mongom e kanekote: “Belbil Tem Am”.
33:20 Suda im weng sin e “El Eloke Isalael” e wiin mongom so. Em mongom e kanekote: “Sunbin-Got e Isalael em Sunbin-Got”.
